title: 2290. Minimum Obstacle Removal to Reach Corner

examples.explanation: We can remove the obstacles at (0, 1) and (0, 2) to create a path from (0, 0) to (2, 2). It can be shown that we need to remove at least 2 obstacles, so we return 2. Note that there may be other ways to remove 2 obstacles to create a path.
We can move from (0, 0) to (2, 4) without removing any obstacles, so we return 0.
